title: Copilot Studio: agent node runs an AI agent as a workflow step
summary: Hold: the briefing incorrectly leaves connector-policy enforcement unresolved even though Microsoft documents environment-wide enforcement covering these connector operations. Two control paths omit documented sections, and the licensing discussion introduces uncertainty about workflow runs that Microsoft's cost table explicitly says are billed.
